verdict_checked: structured_supported (json_api) - replay confirmed, status/deadline fields unreliable

checks.curl_no_cookie_ua: HTTP 200 application/json, cloudflare, x-wp-total 11, no challenge markers

issues: status is hardcoded open for all 11 items; single-record content shows closed/past dates (id 1322 Closed; id 4002 Next submission date March 31, 2026; id 98 portal not open)

deadline is always null; real dates are in content.rendered free text in varying formats (Submission date: January 15th, 2027; Pre-proposal: July 1, 2026; Submission Deadline: 3 months following workshop)
date field is the WP publish/modify date (2024/2026), not a deadline; must not be used as deadline
catalog is program-level (11 programs), so a row maps to program pages, not per-call instances
some items (Pioneer Funding Track, Research Grants) carry notice text about the 2026 round; status cannot be derived from list endpoint
recommended: Either accept only with status suppressed/unknown, or add a json_api detail step (fetch /wp-json/wp/v2/opportunities/{id}?_fields=id,content per item, regex Submission date|Next submission deadline|Submission Deadline). Needs new engine support; prototype not run.
